sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.notes: This sheet shows four exterior elevation views (North, South, East, West) for an industrial tilt-up concrete building for Crow Holdings in Bartow County, Georgia. The primary wall system is Site Cast Concrete Panels (SCCP/tilt-up) with heights of 35'-2" typical and 41'-2" at entry conditions. Exterior finishes are Pittsburgh Paints Perma-Crete acrylic texture coating with colors TBD. No overall building dimensions are printed on this elevation sheet; scales are noted as approximately 1"=49'-0" to 1"=59'-0". ESTIMATOR EXPECTED QUANTITIES (all approximate, set approximate:true): CMU Wall - no CMU walls are indicated on this sheet; the primary wall system is tilt-up SCCP; CMU quantity cannot be determined from this sheet. Internal Tilt-Up Walls/SCCP: Based on four elevations at stated scales, West elevation ~590 LF x 35 ft = ~20,650 SF; South elevation ~500 LF x 35 ft = ~17,500 SF; East elevation ~500 LF x 35 ft = ~17,500 SF; North elevation ~500 LF x 35 ft = ~17,500 SF total gross facade approximately 73,150 SF less openings (dock doors, storefronts, louvers) estimated at ~15% = approximately 62,000 SF net SCCP. Exposed Structure/Metal Roof Deck: Not shown on elevation sheets; refer to structural/roof plan sheets. Sealed Concrete/Slab on Grade: Not shown on elevation sheets; refer to floor plan. Guard Rail: Present at stair/ramp locations per keynote B; quantity not dimensioned on this sheet; estimated 80-160 LF approximate. Hand Rail: Present at stair locations per keynote B; quantity not dimensioned; estimated 40-80 LF approximate. All quantities marked approximate:true as no overall dimensions are printed on this sheet.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a misc. details sheet containing 13 details at various scales (1/4"=1'-0", 3/4"=1'-0", 1/2"=1'-0", 1"=1'-0"). No area quantities are explicitly printed. Estimator-requested quantities: (1) CMU Wall SF - Detail 5 shows 8" CMU wall at pump/electrical room; no plan extent shown on this sheet, quantity cannot be derived here, must come from floor plan sheets. (2) Concrete Slab on Metal Deck SF - shown in Detail 5 but extent not dimensioned on this sheet. (3) SCCP/Tilt-up Panel SF - S.C.C.P. shown in Details 2, 5, 6 at dock and stair; no panel dimensions given on this detail sheet; refer to floor plan/elevation sheets. (4) Sealed Concrete/Slab on Grade SF - slab on grade shown in multiple sections but no area dimensions on this sheet. (5) Guardrail LF - 1-1/2" OD steel pipe guardrail shown at ramp (12'-0" wide ramp plan Detail 13), stair (Details 6, 8, 10), and dock; approximate total guardrail from visible detail geometry estimated at 60-80 LF approximate across all conditions, but exact project-wide quantity requires plan sheets. (6) Handrail LF - 1-1/2" OD handrail shown at ramp and stair sections; project-wide quantity requires plan sheets. All quantities flagged as requiring plan-level sheets for accurate takeoff. Detail 7 bollard is topgard/precast concrete pipe bollard cap type. Note: 'ALL PIPE WILL BE EXTRA STRONG' applies to pipe guardrail/handrail. Project: Crow Holdings Industrial, Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Job No. 30174. NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION.
